hooks.command: python3 -B -c "import pathlib,runpy,sys; p=pathlib.Path.cwd(); ds=(p,*p.parents); g=next((d for d in ds if (d/'.git').exists()),None); w=next((d for d in ds if (d/'.agent-rules/workspace.json').is_file() and (g is None or g.parent==d or d.is_relative_to(g))),None); r=w if w else g; f=r/'.agent-rules'/('workspace_hook.py' if w else 'runtime.py'); sys.path.insert(0,str(f.parent)); runpy.run_path(str(f),run_name='__main__')"
